answer: Weight each seat by proof-of-stake-age: voting power accrues only from the uninterrupted tenure of locked capital, like old cedar no sapling fakes overnight. Moving or splitting the stake resets the clock to zero, so 500 clones must each age a separate bond through the full window independently. The carry cost of idle locked capital recurs every epoch and compounds per clone, so a sybil farm pays a convex, time-integrated toll, not a one-time fee. A long-held identity stains the ledger with durable pigment; a fresh clone is only a hollow echo of tenure it never served.
